description: This file defines a class 'Zend_Oauth_Provider' within the 'SuiteCRM' namespace, implementing core OAuth provider functionalities such as request validation, token management, signature verification, and error reporting.

classes.name: Zend_Oauth_Provider
classes.description: A class implementing OAuth provider functionalities, including request validation, signature checking, token handling, and error reporting.

methods.name: setConsumerHandler
methods.description: Assigns a callback for handling consumer key validation

methods.name: setTimestampNonceHandler
methods.description: Assigns a callback for handling nonce and timestamp validation

methods.name: setTokenHandler
methods.description: Assigns a callback for handling token validation

methods.name: setRequestTokenPath
methods.description: Sets the URL path for requesting tokens

methods.name: isRequestTokenEndpoint
methods.description: Marks the current request as a token endpoint

methods.name: reportProblem
methods.description: Generates an error message string based on an exception during OAuth processing

methods.name: needsToken
methods.description: Determines whether the current request requires a token

methods.name: checkRequiredParams
methods.description: Validates presence of all required OAuth parameters

methods.name: checkSignatureMethod
methods.description: Checks if the provided signature method is supported

methods.name: assembleParams
methods.description: Collects all OAuth parameters from request headers, GET, and POST data

methods.name: getRequestUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full request URL

methods.name: getOAuthParams
methods.description: Returns the OAuth parameters extracted from the request

methods.name: checkOAuthRequest
methods.description: Validates an incoming OAuth request, verifying signatures, tokens, and parameters

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a random token string of specified length
